name: Dreary Village
desc1: This appears to be a small town nestled in the centre of the valley.
desc2: It presents a disheartening sight, even vaguely disturbing, as it is
desc3: constructed largely of grey stone and charcoal-coloured wood. Torches
desc4: set in the sides of the buildings provide the only light. A strong-
desc5: looking stone structure with an iron door stands to the north, and an
desc6: evil-looking building of black stone is to the south. Engraved on its
desc7: dark wooden door is a hideous horned skull.
